registration: Internal repository freeze; Git commit records publication. Not an external preregistration and not blind to the known temperature anomaly.

source_model.interpretation: GR plus canonical quadratic quintessence and standard matter; no rotation term. Equivalent physical class is not novel EFMW rotation.

predictions.target: Background fundamental comoving-fluid vorticity and retained linear scalar-mode vorticity
predictions.status: Conditional mathematical prediction of the frozen model
predictions.scope: Exact FLRW background and linear scalar perturbations with zero primordial vectors; excludes nonlinear vector generation and astrophysical local spins from this assertion.

predictions.target: Full-sky unlensed linear Gaussian TT quadrupole-octopole axis alignment
predictions.axis_definition: Largest-eigenvalue axis of Q_ij=Re[(L_i a)^dagger(L_j a)]; n equivalent to -n
predictions.scope: Independent isotropic Gaussian multipoles with positive C_l. Not the fully processed instrumental, foreground-contaminated or lensed-sky likelihood.

predictions.meaning: No preferred direction in the ensemble; every headless direction is equally distributed. One realization may align by chance.

coordinates.units: degrees in records; radians in trigonometry

new_computational_test.purpose: Prospective numerical calibration of the P2 distribution; not physical validation or a recreation of the historical PBH simulation.
new_computational_test.generator: xoshiro128** with explicit SplitMix32 initialization in pinned benchmark.cjs
new_computational_test.draw_order: For each i=0..N-1: core.alm(2,rng), core.alm(3,rng), then compute both axes and A23; cached Box-Muller state is shared and retained.
new_computational_test.sampling: C_l=1; a_l0 real N(0,1); positive-m real and imaginary parts N(0,1/2); a_l,-m=(-1)^m conjugate(a_lm).
new_computational_test.threshold_rule: D_N <= sqrt(log(2/alpha)/(2*N)); finite-sample Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz bound under independent uniform draws
diagnostics_only: counts at the three fixed angular windows
new_computational_test.interpretation: A flag may be a stochastic tail event or implementation defect; it is not a physical falsification of EFMW. Compatibility is not validation of the cosmology.
new_computational_test.stop_rule: One fixed-N execution; retain every result. No seed/threshold/sample-size change after seeing output. Deterministic reruns are reproduction, not extra independent evidence.

implementation.runtime: Node >=20; record actual Node/V8 versions with output.

known_evidence.temperature_analysis: WMAP9 ILC axes, its DQ variants, all 13 published variants in observations.json, and previous null results were known before this lock.
known_evidence.restriction: Never count any of these results or another reduction of the same sky as a new independent discovery under this lock.

requirements: Freeze exact data release/files/checksums and predeclared eligibility without inspecting the target statistic.
Freeze foreground, mask/inpainting, kinematic correction, calibration, beam/noise and lensing treatments with matched null processing.
Freeze the complete statistic/map/axis/model search; repeat any selection on every null realization.
For polarization conditioned on known temperature, include TE correlation and shared cosmic variance; do not assume independent T and E axes.
Name actual unexamined observables and document information already seen; a new satellite observing the same sky is not an independent cosmic realization.
Select physical likelihood, uncertainty and decision thresholds before evaluating those data.

required_before_lock: Covariant equations, field/observer definitions, source terms, units and initial/boundary conditions.
Derived nonzero vorticity or explicitly labeled inherited initial rotation, with zero-source/isotropic controls.
Quantitative TT/TE/EE and, where applicable, handedness/redshift predictions with fixed parameters and uncertainty.
Likelihood comparison with non-rotating anisotropic alternatives and held-out observables.
rotating_extension.rule: A rotating extension requires a new model and a new versioned prediction lock; no retrofitting this v1 after seeing future results.

revision_policy: Append-only versions. Preserve v1, its failures and known-data ledger. Physics, seeds, data, estimator, thresholds or search changes require a new version before evaluation. A digest proves byte identity, not blindness or correctness.
zoo_status: Freeze/anti-circularity discipline applied; no canonical animal operation or full-Zoo certification claimed.
